advantagesAndTradeoffs.macflyPro: The historical directory highlights duplicate handling and uninstall workflows (C3); these may be evaluation criteria but are not verified current advantages or hands-on results. Do not claim Breathing Room matches those workflows or that MacFly Pro lacks monitoring.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.breathingRoom: Reused register supports local storage inspection, grouped CPU/memory source implementation and developer-cache discovery. Potential fit for inspection and reviewable maintenance, not proof of binary parity, speed, safety or recovered bytes.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.breathingRoomLimits: Preview 0.1.0-preview.1, macOS 13+, Python 3.10+, no notarization/Developer ID claim, clean-machine/physical-Intel unvalidated. Hosted authenticated AI sends relevant context to service; optional paid AI Care. Exact approvals are mode-dependent, including optional verified Ruff automatic Trash mode; never promise unconditional per-action approval.
advantagesAndTradeoffs.whenNotToChoose: Do not steer users needing production-validated installation or a verified duplicate/uninstall replacement toward this preview on unsupported equivalence. Manual inspection is an option; native macOS workflow details would require official Apple sources before a tutorial.
